residency.method: Three rotated-order rounds at each budget; fresh profiles, warm OS cache, identical local T1_Fatal/mp/ffa3/T1_Fatal cycle; no concurrent build or other game client.
residency.limit: Repeated loads improved; the first map was effectively unchanged. This is not a matched SJK comparison.

worker_decode_world_scope.method: Same prototype binary, three alternating pairs, 2048 MiB GPU residency, disk cache off; fresh profiles, warm OS cache, no compilation/static analysis/other game client.
worker_decode_world_scope.limit: First two loads improved; revisit did not. This measures world-scope prototype, not final broader registration.

prepared_cache_world_scope.method: Three rotated-order rounds off/cold/warm, same binary/settings, 2048 MiB GPU residency, automatic workers. Pipeline cache seeded identically; warm textures copied before timer. No concurrent build/analysis/game.
prepared_cache_world_scope.decision: No overall speed gain in this prototype; default disabled. Final broader registration requires separate measurements.

navigation.limit: Filesystem call count and byte-identical roundtrip checks, not a wall-clock claim.

registration_decode.method: Same binary, three alternating pairs, GPU cache2048MiB, diskoff, fresh profiles,warmOS cache, no concurrentlocalCPU work.

checkpoint_features.method: Three rotated-order rounds; one feature disabled at a time in same binary; cache2048MiB, decoderworkersauto,diskoff,freshprofiles,warmOS cache,quietmachine.

release_lto.method: Three alternating pairs of clean MSVC x64 Release builds; identical 599 compiler contexts after removing /GL, byte-identical assets/dependencies, same 5005-frame seven-bot mp/ffa3 demo, seeded pipeline cache, fresh profiles, quiet machine. LTO links alone use /LTCG.
release_lto.limit: About 4.5% in this replay. Does not establish live server simulation/input prediction gains or an SJK lead.

source_prefix_initial.method: Three alternating same-binary pairs; prefix0/1, cache2048MiB, diskoff, quiet machine. Initial run has a cold outlier; first-map effect is uncertain.
source_prefix_initial.decision: Keep experimental until additional primed pairs.
source_prefix_initial.superseded_decision: The initial default-0 decision was superseded by five primed pairs; the current default is 1.

minizip_directory.method: Seven alternating warmed MSVC x64 Release pairs after one discarded warmup pair; actual parser visits and metadata lookup produce two central-header parses per installed entry.
minizip_directory.compatibility: Names, metadata, offsets, extras/comments and extraction fingerprints match; zero extraction failures. Synthetic scalar/truncation/CRC cases passed x64/x86 and x64 ASAN.
minizip_directory.limit: 18.56% less warm parser scan time; this is not complete startup, joining or FPS.

filesystem_restart_cache.method: Three alternating real-server pairs on 13.140.233.106, yavin_temple_mp2, matching settings and isolated profiles; unchanged archive metadata is reused within the ordinary checksum-feed restart.
filesystem_restart_cache.decision: Enabled by default after stable remount savings; explicit 0 remains supported and saved user values are not forced.
filesystem_restart_cache.limit: Initial mount is unchanged; complete join includes server/network variation. This measurement is separate from other loading features.

source_prefix_primed.method: Five alternating same-binary pairs after one unmeasured priming pair; identical pipeline seeds, fresh profiles, warm OS cache, 2048 MiB residency, filesystem restart reuse on, disk cache off and no competing local work.
source_prefix_primed.decision: Adopt source-prefix validation by default after consistent primed load improvements; explicit 0 preserves full validation.
source_prefix_primed.limit: Warm local one-player cycle, not disk-cold or a matched SJK comparison; percentages cannot be added to other experiments.

zlib_ng.default: UseZlibNG=ON when UseInternalZlib=ON and supported; classic explicit OFF and external zlib remain available
zlib_ng.portability: Static compat API, runtime CPU detection and generic fallbacks ON; host-native ISA and all dependency IPO configurations OFF. CMake <3.14, unsupported compilers and multiple distinct macOS target architectures use classic zlib.

library.method: Three alternating warmed x64 Release/LTO harness pairs, actual minizip and production PNG decoder; only zlib backend changes. PNG trial is the median of five decode passes.
library.limit: About 21% less time in these isolated codec workloads, not whole-game loading.

local_client.method: Five alternating clean same-source Release/LTO pairs after one warmup pair; matching minizip/PNG, asset containers/DLLs, pipeline seeds, 2048 MiB GPU cache, filesystem reuse and prefix validation ON, fresh profiles, quiet machine.
local_client.limit: Complete three-map cycle effectively flat; first/second handoff differences are small and noisy.

remote_client.method: Three alternating matched clean-client pairs on 13.140.233.106, yavin_temple_mp2; no simultaneous clients or competing CPU work.
remote_client.limit: Cgame/graphics about 7.7% shorter and all three paired cgame loads improve; complete join about 3.8% shorter with effectively unchanged gamestate arrival. Network/server variation remains; no universal loading, FPS or SJK claim.

zlib_ng.focused_verification: Actual production chooser/minizip/PNG fixtures passed x64/x86 ASAN for both backends; generic and ISA-specific NG compile commands contain no /GL, generic functions no forced AVX. Mixed-architecture chooser policy has a guard-disabled failing control. Current whole-project production integration remains pending.

idle_crowd_diagnostic.method: One quiet coarse and one fine instrumented 5005-frame mp/duel1 idle-crowd replay; 24 bots, AI/movement frozen while ordinary client/Ghoul2 animation remains active.
idle_crowd_diagnostic.limit: Diagnostic only: packet entities account for about 75% of this sampled cgame call. Clock instrumentation affects timing, nested totals overlap and renderer denominators differ. This is idle population, not combat/live prediction/server simulation, and establishes no speed improvement.

shadow_mark_clipping.method: Five alternating pairs after one unmeasured warmup pair; same 5005-frame 24-bot idle crowd, identical cgame/engine/assets/settings and pipeline seeds, fresh profiles, profiling disabled, no concurrent compilation/analysis/game.
shadow_mark_clipping.change: Vulkan polygon clipping omits two fully overwritten 68-element temporary array initializers and rejects empty input before sentinel reads. Vanilla receives the equivalent correctness/work change.
shadow_mark_clipping.verification: Actual production Vulkan/vanilla clippers and scalar vector math produce identical complete output buffers for 12000 randomized convex polygons, boundaries and sequential six-plane clips; x64 ASan and x86 Release pass; old code fails the avoided-initialization check.
shadow_mark_clipping.limit: About 2.1% median FPS in this idle replay; all five paired updated trials were faster, but both variants drifted during the sequence. Not a live combat/prediction/general FPS or SJK claim. Source initialization counts alone do not prove emitted machine stores. Separate from the LTO experiment.

animation_event_index.method: Five alternating uninstrumented pairs after one warmup pair, fresh profiles, same 5005-frame idle 24-bot demo and pipeline seeds; clean abecf71/85b9324 cgame builds, 58 normalized compile contexts and embedded metadata match; only cgame DLL differs. No concurrent build/analyzer/game.
animation_event_index.fixture: 8007 cases, 11778 identical dispatches/RNG/state mutations; visited catalogue slots 1167727 to 63661. x64 ASan and x86 Release pass; actual parser includes/reset/cache/stomp lifecycle covered.
animation_event_index.limit: About 0.5% median FPS in this idle replay, with both variants drifting during the sequence. The later live diagnostic confirms all queries indexed, but dispatch dominates. The 94.5% fixture slot reduction is not an equivalent game-speed claim. Separate from clipping/LTO/loading experiments.

single_pass_archive_catalogue.method: Same x64 Release/LTO prototype binary, fs_zipCatalogFast 0/1 only; five alternating pairs after one warmup pair; fresh profiles, warm OS cache, matching pipeline seeds, 2048 MiB residency, fs_restartCache 1 and texture prefix 1, ordinary texture/audio/renderer settings. No concurrent compiler/analyzer/other game; other-client checks before/after each trial.

corpus.verification: Complete FS catalogues, order, hash chains, names/indexes, checksum words, pure/nonpure owners/sizes/positions and reference flags match. Both x64 ASan and x86 Release pass, plus 309 synthetic/error/state/payload cases and both restart-cache modes.

single_pass_archive_catalogue.fallback: fs_zipCatalogFast 0 selects a fresh legacy navigation/GetInfo scan; generic minizip APIs unchanged. New combined iterator invalidates current on combined parse errors; FS rejects/closes it and never retries mid-iterator.
single_pass_archive_catalogue.limit: About 30% shorter initial filesystem stage and 5.9% shorter complete local cycle, with every paired trial improving. This is not 30% faster whole-game loading or an SJK claim, and percentages must not be compounded with earlier experiments.

footstep_dispatch_diagnostic.replay: same idle 24-bot recording; cg_runtimeProfile 2, default cg_footsteps 3, software sound (s_useOpenAL 0)
footstep_dispatch_diagnostic.limit: Nested instrumented owning-thread times identify sound submission as about 92% of this footstep group; they are not a frame-rate improvement or every-scene claim.

sound_cache_clock_diagnostic.finding: The old Com_Milliseconds cache touch pumps the OS/journal event path; Windows reaches console-input polling. About90% of the sampled submission cost is the cache clock.

sound_cache_clock_diagnostic.limit: Instrumented cost diagnosis and fixture work counts. Actual-game speed comparison is not yet complete. Null/nonzero journal states retain the legacy clock.
